6c85628378.q: What are the three main signals that matter to AI for business recommendations?
6c85628378.a: The three signals are: (1) location—your name, address, and phone number being accurate; (2) reputation—what people say about you online, especially on your Google Business page and reviews; and (3) website content—when people ask specific questions, AI platforms pull information from business websites to provide recommendations.

c5fdf31a33.q: Should businesses stop paid search (SEM) to invest entirely in AI optimization?
c5fdf31a33.a: No. Right now, SEM is paid search where you pay when someone clicks, while AI recommendation is an organic service similar to traditional SEO. SEM cannot be controlled like AI, and Google still handles about 70% of U.S. desktop searches. Dropping SEM would cause website traffic to nosedive because you would disappear from consumers at the moment they're ready to buy.
